product_one_liner.value: Druid AI enables enterprises to build, deploy and orchestrate AI agents that automate business processes and customer and employee interactions across existing systems.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes custom enterprise pricing plans and included services; pricing requires a tailored quote rather than published dollar amounts.

employee_band.notes: Reported headcounts of 216 and approximately 222 fall within this band.

eng_blog.notes: The blog contains architecture and evaluation articles, but the relevant identified authors are product-marketing staff; two engineer-authored posts about building the product were not established.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes model configuration, governance, authentication and resource-management articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Accessible openings include Technical Consultant and Developer Advocate roles, but no qualifying AI, ML or data-science title was found.

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Mistral AI, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Druid Becus, Mesolitica, LLaMA and GPT OSS
model_provider.notes: The platform is LLM-agnostic; these are explicitly supported models/providers, not a claim that every deployment uses all of them.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the certifications the company explicitly says the platform holds. HIPAA is discussed separately as compliance, not a product certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The $31 million Series C was announced September 16, 2025, within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An accessible Business Development Representative posting accepts applications and lists BDR/SDR experience.

launched_6mo.notes: On October 14, 2026, Druid announced new voice, agent-interoperability, governance and evaluation capabilities, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Michael Yang joined Druid in December 2025 according to his profile; official company sources identify him as VP of Product Marketing in June 2026 and Chief Strategy Officer in October 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Sales recruiting names HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator; the BDR-manager description explicitly requires complete handoff records in HubSpot.
